directed.conceptual_reading: This is a criterion-design template rather than a particular theorem: kernel choice jointly determines boundary decay, sampled zeta data, residue terms, and the visibility of off-line zeros. Productive search must optimize all of these constraints together.
directed.representation_or_bridge: The generalized Littlewood contour formula is the bridge from a chosen vertical-line functional to poles and zero contributions; an RH criterion emerges only if the clean baseline is computable and the omitted-zero correction is sign-definite or otherwise identifiable.
directed.boundary_or_failure: The span gives no existence result for a decisive kernel and no search or completeness theorem. Admissible decay, singularity placement, logarithm branches, convergence, and noncancellation of zero corrections remain proof burdens for every proposed g.
directed.uncertainty: High confidence in the stated construction heuristic; no evidence in this conclusion supports the aspiration that one of these criteria can practically prove or disprove RH.
